mods.title_zh: 蘇清的酿酒技能书50倍补丁

mods.summary_en: Sets only Chinese Cuisine brewing-book maxima to 50, retains native 10-percent reading steps and synchronizes actual read pages. No direct XP or level award. Restore original multipliers and save before disabling.

mods.summary_en: Shares occupancy checks for the 38 boat/3x6 RV slots, retains existing interiors and blocks conflicting entry. B42.21 single-player only; in-game acceptance pending.

mods.summary_en: Native nearby inputs for three boat recipes; ingredients, surface and weight retained.
